strengths: Recovery composes existing M6 gameplay/replay, canonical M4 Item Graph, MW5 Matter persistence and M0/C17 Construction owners instead of introducing duplicate canonical truth.
Restart proof crosses real OS process boundaries for gameplay, terrain/Matter and Construction/collision and preserves exact canonical checksums/identities.
Live graphical gate replaces client A with a fresh sixth ENet process, resyncs current terrain/material/Construction state, re-derives 100 collision parts and continues fixed-tick movement.
MVP7 backend liveness keeps existing authenticated authority links active without changing timeout policy or silently reconnecting a backend; true disconnect/RPC failure remains fatal.
FINISH success is delivery-bound: gateway closes only after the reconnect client received FINISH ACK and closed its peer.

findings.summary: Fresh independent Reviewer and Verifier must bind to frozen ad48b24d/f306e84e; implementer CI is not an independent verdict.
Leaf closure still needs exact-head full world/core and standard/directional PC0 non-red evidence or an explicit policy-backed classification.
Restart guarantee is from an acknowledged quiescent checkpoint; arbitrary power-loss of uncheckpointed operations is not claimed.
Server/world restart and live ENet client reconnect are proven as separate exact-head gates, not as one simultaneous outage scenario; MVP8 remains the connected bounded-workload composition stage.
